entries.text: Several weeks ago in Knoxville, Tennessee, four japanese nationals were murdered. All prominent doctors apparently engaged in a highly classified project.
entries.speaker: Richard Matheson
entries.location: OFFICE OF SENATOR RICHARD MATHESON ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What kind of project? The autopsy of an extraterrestrial life-form. Was that part of it?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: OFFICE OF SENATOR RICHARD MATHESON ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I can't tell you. Some secrets do remain secret, Fox, even to me. I was only just now given the names of the murdered scientists. Their credentials, however, are a matter of public record. Past deeds which may illuminate present treacheries. Your time is limited. Before you become, as you say, entangled in this... Past the point of being about to... Fully understand or expose it.
entries.speaker: Richard Matheson
entries.location: OFFICE OF SENATOR RICHARD MATHESON ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What am I onto here?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: OFFICE OF SENATOR RICHARD MATHESON ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Monsters begetting monsters.
entries.speaker: Richard Matheson
entries.location: OFFICE OF SENATOR RICHARD MATHESON ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ knocking at door ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Why is the door locked?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I have something to show you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Do you have any idea where I've been?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Allentown?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I went to go see those MUFON members to find out about that woman, betsy Hagopian.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: What'd you find?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I found out that she's dying, along with a lot of other women who claim to be dying too. All of them who say that they had these implanted in them.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: But you're fine, aren't you, Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Am I? I don't know, Mulder. Th-they said that they know me. That they've seen me before. It was freaky. They know things about me, about my disappearance.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Well, that is disturbing. But I don't think you should freak out until we find out what this thing is.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: [ phone ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Mulder. I got a fax coming.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: What is this?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: That's a group of japanese medical officers taken during world war ii.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I've seen this man before.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: No, I don't think so. Not unless you were in japan in the last 50 years.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: No, I've seen him before.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: His name is dr. Takeo Ishimaru. He's been dead since 1965. He was the commander of an elite section of the japanese medical corps known as 731, a unit now known to have experimented on human subjects. They performed vivisections without anesthesia, tested frostbite tolerance levels on infants, exposed innocent prisoners of war to diseases, the plague. Like their nazi counterparts, they were never brought to justice.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: What are you doing with these?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Four of the doctors you see were on that videotape I showed you performing that autopsy.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Yeah, but they were in full surgical dress. You couldn't tell one from the other.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Somebody could, because those same four men were murdered yesterday. Found here right on u.s. Soil. [ beeping ]
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Murdered for what?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: That's what I'd like to know.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Or murdered by whom?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Possibly our government.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Our government? For what possible reason?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: For continuing their work, the work the nazis were doing. Trying to create an alien/human hybrid.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: That is still a fantasy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Scully, after all you've seen-- after all you've told me you've seen-- the tunnel filled with medical files, the beings moving past you, the implant in your neck, why do you refuse to believe?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Believing's the easy part, Mulder. I just need more than you. I need proof.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: You think that believing is easy? [ beeping ] well, we have proof. I identified what those five photos were tracking. A ship that pulled a UFO off the bottom of the pacific ocean, a UFO that's in a warehouse right now being guarded by u.s. Military personnel. A UFO that was probably carrying that e.b.e. We saw on that autopsy tape.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: What am I looking at?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Part of our government's secret railroad. Train cars used to carry test subjects, used to conduct that autopsy we saw being performed.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Where did you get this?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: From someone like you who wants proof. Who's also willing to believe.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Hmm. Amazing.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: Do you know what it is?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Looks like some kind of microprocessor.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: So you're saying that this is manmade.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What else would it be? I mean, it's definitely state of the art.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: [ beeping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: The microlithography is extremely complex. I've never seen anything even close to this density.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: Any way of finding out who manufactures it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Uh, there are a few companies out in san jose, a couple in boston. It could be any one of them.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: What are these chips used for?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Video games, brake systems. They're finding new apps every day. I read about one being designed to help the disabled operate computers using brain waves.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: How?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Through direct electrochemical interface with the cerebral cortex. Pretty incredible, huh?
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The train yard in quinnimont, West Virginia. A group of japanese men just put someone in one of those boxcars we saw in the satellite photos.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I thought you said that it was our government's railroad.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Something serious is going down here, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: The thing they put in the train, it was alive.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Mulder--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: I gotta get on that train. It's hooking up with a canadian passenger train outside cincinnati.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON D.C.

entries.text: Mulder, I was right about dr. Ishimaru. He isn't dead. In fact, he's on your videotape.

entries.text: That's where you know him from then.
